mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointment_idempotency (user_id, request_key, request_hash, appointment_id, deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{requestKey}, #{requestHash}, NULL, 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM appointment_idempotency WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_key = #{requestKey} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
